name: SK Hynix
day_summary: SK Hynix crashed ₩154,000 (-9.27%) to ₩1,508,000 on Aug 19 — the worst single-session loss since the framework's re-entry period began Aug 12 — as a spike in the 30-year U.S. Treasury yield to 5.336% (a 19-year high) triggered a global risk-off selloff that took the KOSPI down 5.4-6.8% and hammered the Korean chip complex. The gate at ₩1,483,000 survived by a margin of just ₩25,000 / 1.7%: the session low was ₩1,501,000, only ₩18,000 above the step-aside trigger. The framework HOLD posture stands, but conviction is immediately downgraded to LOW. NOTE on Aug 18 data: the prior dossier (Aug 18) reported a close of ₩1,754,000; actual market close on Aug 18 was ₩1,662,000 (confirmed by today's prev_close and Seoul Economic Daily's -₩154,000 drop figure). The -9.27% decline and today's ₩1,508,000 close are calculated from the ₩1,662,000 actual Aug 18 close. Framework re-entry entry remains ₩1,504,000 (Aug 12); today's close is now only ₩4,000 / +0.27% above the re-entry level. The ₩25,000 / 1.7% gate buffer is the narrowest since the framework began.
long_pnl: Framework long from ₩1,504,000 (Aug 12 re-entry) is essentially flat: ₩1,508,000 close is +₩4,000 / +0.27% above entry. Session low of ₩1,501,000 put the long briefly underwater by ₩3,000 before recovering to close ₩4,000 above entry. The framework is still long but all paper gains are gone. Any close below ₩1,483,000 immediately triggers step-aside and locks in a loss from the ₩1,504,000 entry.
short_pnl: Shorts entered above ₩1,550,000 or at the Aug 19 open were paid handsomely: a short from ₩1,559,000 (today's session high) to the ₩1,501,000 session low captured ₩58,000 / -3.7% intraday. Any short that covered at ₩1,501,000-₩1,508,000 realized maximum profit. Structural bears who maintain positions below ₩1,483,000 as a target are within ₩25,000 of triggering the step-aside gate; if the gate breaks, systematic selling from framework longs would amplify downside.

decision.horizon: through NVDA Q2 FY2027 earnings (Aug 26); gate: close below ₩1,483,000 triggers immediate step-aside; next catalyst: Aug 26 NVDA Q2 earnings — beat required to rebuild conviction
decision.rationale: Conviction downgraded from HIGH (Aug 18) to LOW. The gate at ₩1,483,000 has not been breached — HOLD stands mechanically — but the ₩25,000 / 1.7% gate buffer is the narrowest in the framework's re-entry period and a single weak KRX session could trigger step-aside. The cause (30-year Treasury yield spike to 5.336%) is macro, not SK Hynix-specific: HBM4 mass shipments to NVIDIA are ongoing and the fundamental HBM demand thesis is unchanged. However, a macro-driven yield shock of this magnitude can persist 1-3 sessions before resolution, and the current buffer does not allow for additional downside without a decision. The framework posture is mechanical HOLD until ₩1,483,000 closes — but LOW conviction reflects the genuine risk of a gate breach on Aug 20 if global yields remain elevated or the KOSPI opens lower.

so_what.line: Gate barely survived: ₩25,000 / 1.7% above step-aside trigger; all Aug 12-18 gains wiped in one session; HOLD stands mechanically but LOW conviction — one weak open on Aug 20 could end the position.
so_what.bull: The 30-year yield spike that caused today's selloff is a macro event, not a fundamental change in SK Hynix's HBM4 order book. The US Treasury's doubled buyback program partially reversed the yield spike (5.336% → ~5.18%) by end of day; if yields stabilize Aug 20, the ₩1,508,000 close becomes a technical support floor and the 7-day path to NVDA Aug 26 earnings remains intact. The HBM demand thesis — HBM4 mass shipments to NVIDIA, ₩54.3T capex plan, 58% HBM market share — is completely unchanged by a Treasury yield move.
so_what.bear: The ₩25,000 / 1.7% gate buffer is not a margin of safety — it is one bad open. A gap-down of 1.7% or more on Aug 20 (entirely plausible if US 30-year yields re-spike or KOSPI opens weak) triggers step-aside and locks in a loss from the ₩1,504,000 entry. The session low of ₩1,501,000 was only ₩18,000 above the gate intraday today. The stock has now round-tripped the entire Aug 12-18 rally in a single session on a macro catalyst unrelated to SK Hynix's own business.

analysis:
## Technical Analysis

### The Gate-Scare Session — Framework's Most Critical Day Since Re-Entry

August 19 is the most dangerous session in the SK Hynix re-entry framework since August 12. The ₩154,000 / -9.27% decline — driven entirely by a macro yield shock (30-year Treasury to 5.336%, 19-year high) — has compressed the gate buffer from ₩271,000 / +18.3% (the widest on record, as of the prior dossier) to ₩25,000 / 1.7% in a single session.

### Gate Buffer History — From Expansion to Near-Breach

| Date | Close | Gate Buffer | Change |
|------|-------|-------------|--------|
| Aug 12 (Day 1) | ₩1,504,000 | +₩21,000 / +1.4% | Re-entry |
| Aug 13 (Day 2) | ₩1,593,000 | +₩110,000 / +7.4% | Building |
| Aug 14 (Day 3) | ₩1,640,000 | +₩157,000 / +10.6% | Building |
| Aug 17 (flat) | ₩1,645,000 | +₩162,000 / +10.9% | Stable |
| Aug 18 (actual) | ₩1,662,000 | +₩179,000 / +12.1% | Building |
| **Aug 19 (today)** | **₩1,508,000** | **+₩25,000 / +1.7%** | **DANGER ZONE** |

Note: Aug 18 prior dossier reported ₩1,754,000 close (inaccurate); corrected to ₩1,662,000 actual market close.

### Session Structure

The KRX session opened at approximately ₩1,559,000 (today's high — sellers dominated from the open on macro risk-off) and declined sharply through the morning on KOSPI-wide selling pressure. The ₩1,501,000 intraday low (only ₩18,000 above the ₩1,483,000 gate) was reached mid-session before buyers stepped in — likely a combination of technical support at the gate zone and short-covering — recovering to the ₩1,508,000 close.

The session structure (open-at-high, immediate decline, gate-zone recovery) is consistent with an institutional distribution event driven by macro rotation rather than fundamental selling.

### ★ Strongest Support — ₩1,483,000 (Framework Gate)

The gate has never been tested this closely:
- ₩25,000 / 1.7% buffer at close — minimum of the entire re-entry period
- Intraday minimum: ₩1,501,000 (₩18,000 above gate) — the closest intraday approach
- Aug 20 gap-down ≥1.7% = automatic step-aside at the open
- No averaging, no waiting: the framework rule is mechanical

### ★ Strongest Resistance — ₩1,662,000 (Actual Aug 18 Close)

With today's -9.27% decline, the actual Aug 18 close (₩1,662,000) becomes the primary overhead resistance:
- Represents the entire single-session loss to be recovered
- +₩154,000 / +10.2% above today's close
- Recapturing ₩1,662,000 requires a session as strong as Aug 13 (+5.92%) or Aug 18 (+6.63% on actual-close basis) — possible but requires a strong macro reversal and/or positive pre-NVDA earnings flow

### What Aug 20 Must Deliver

| Scenario | Gate Buffer After Aug 20 | Framework Decision |
|----------|--------------------------|--------------------|
| Gap-down ≥1.7% (open ≤₩1,483,000) | 0 — breach | Step-aside immediately |
| Flat to -1.7% (open ₩1,483,000-₩1,508,000) | ₩0-₩25,000 | HOLD — critical watch |
| +1-3% (₩1,523,000-₩1,553,000) | ₩40,000-₩70,000 | HOLD — slight relief |
| +3.4% (₩1,559,000 — today's high) | ₩76,000 / 5.1% | HOLD — buffer begins |
| +10.2% recovery (₩1,662,000) | ₩179,000 / 12.1% | HOLD — Aug 18 status restored |

### The Yield Context

The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield at 5.336% is the proximate cause of every number in today's dossier. The historical context:
- 5.336% = 19-year high (last seen 2007)
- The US Treasury doubled its buyback program on Aug 19, which produced a partial reversal (est. 5.336% → 5.18%)
- If the buyback suppresses yields durably, the macro headwind that caused today's selloff diminishes
- If yields re-accelerate above 5.3% on Aug 20, the probability of a gate breach approaches 50%+

The framework cannot trade macro yield policy — it can only respond to the KRX close relative to ₩1,483,000. The Aug 20 close is the single input that matters.
